title_en: The Oath of the Peach Garden
page_text_ocr_zh:
桃园三结义
幼儿版
page_text_en:
The Oath of the Peach Garden
Children's Edition
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《桃园三结义》的封面，展示了三位卡通人物在桌前焚香结义的场景，旁边标注“幼儿版”，表明这是为幼儿改编的版本。

title_en: The Oath of the Peach Garden
page_text_ocr_zh: 从前有个叫张飞的人开了一家肉店，生意红火极了！张飞每天都会准备很多肉，夏天时，他就把肉放在门前的井里，再用一块千斤重的石头压住井口。
page_text_en: Long ago, a man named Zhang Fei opened a meat shop, and his business was extremely prosperous! Every day, Zhang Fei would prepare a lot of meat. In summer, he would put the meat in the well in front of his shop and cover the well with a stone weighing a thousand jin.
summary_zh: 本页讲述了张飞开肉店并用井保存肉品的故事，画面中张飞站在肉店前，旁边有井和肉店招牌。

title_en: The Oath of the Peach Garden
page_text_ocr_zh:
人，搬
白
石头的
“肯定没有人比我的
力气更大啦！”张飞笑
呵呵地在纸上写下：“搬
动石头的人，送肉一块。”
然后贴到了石头上。
page_text_en:
Person, move
White
Stone
"Definitely no one has more strength than me!" Zhang Fei laughed happily as he wrote on the paper: "Whoever moves the stone, gets a piece of meat." Then he stuck it onto the stone.
summary_zh: 张飞在石头上写下‘搬动石头的人，送肉一块’的告示，并将其贴在石头上，以展示自己的力气。

title_en: The Oath of the Peach Garden
page_text_ocr_zh: 他又把另一些肉放在车上，晃晃悠悠地去集市上卖肉了。
page_text_en: He then put some more meat on the cart and went to the market to sell it, swaying along the way.
summary_zh: 张飞将一些肉放在车上，晃晃悠悠地前往集市卖肉。

title_en: The Oath of the Peach Garden
page_text_ocr_zh:
这时，一位长胡须、细眼浓眉的人推着车恰好走到这里。他叫关羽，准备去集市上卖绿豆。他实在是太渴了，看到有口井，就准备弄点水喝。
人，搬动石头
一块。送肉
page_text_en:
At this moment, a man with long beard, narrow eyes, and thick eyebrows pushed his cart and arrived here. His name was Guan Yu, and he was heading to the market to sell mung beans. He was extremely thirsty, and seeing a well, he prepared to get some water to drink.
Person, move the stone
One piece. Give meat
summary_zh: 本页描绘了关羽推车路过，准备在井边喝水，旁边石头上贴着张飞写的‘搬动石头的人，送肉一块’的告示。

title_en: The Oath of the Peach Garden
page_text_ocr_zh: 关羽看见了石头上的字条，高兴极了，走上前去一下就把大石头搬走了。
page_text_en: Guan Yu saw the note on the stone, was very happy, and walked forward to move the big stone away in one go.
summary_zh: 关羽看到石头上的字条后，高兴地走上前，轻松地搬走了大石头。

title_en: The Oath of the Peach Garden
page_text_ocr_zh: 喝完水，他“唰”地一刀割走了一块猪肉，放到了自己的小车上，然后哼哼呀呀地去集市上卖绿豆了。
page_text_en: After drinking water, he 'swish' cut off a piece of pork with one stroke, put it on his little cart, and then went off to the market to sell mung beans, humming and hawing.
summary_zh: 关羽喝完水后，割下一块猪肉放在小车上，然后哼着歌去集市卖绿豆。

title_en: The Oath of the Peach Garden
page_text_ocr_zh:
店里的小伙计看见了，
慌慌张张地跑来告诉张飞：
“不好啦！店里的肉被一个卖绿豆的偷走啦！”
page_text_en:
The shop assistant saw it and ran over to Zhang Fei, panicked:
"Oh no! The meat in the shop has been stolen by a mung bean seller!"
summary_zh: 店里的小伙计发现肉被偷，慌张地跑去告诉张飞，称肉被一个卖绿豆的人偷走了。

title_en: The Oath of the Peach Garden
page_text_ocr_zh: 张飞一听，气得跳了起来，哇哇呀呀地满市场里找卖绿豆的。
page_text_en: Zhang Fei, upon hearing this, jumped up in anger, shouting and yelling as he searched the market for the man selling mung beans.
summary_zh: 张飞得知肉被卖绿豆的人拿走后，非常生气，跳起来满市场寻找那个卖绿豆的人。

title_en: The Oath of the Peach Garden
page_text_ocr_zh: 不一会儿，张飞就看见了关羽，发现他的小车上放着一块猪肉。张飞大吼道：“原来是你偷走了我的肉，还我肉来！”
page_text_en: In no time, Zhang Fei spotted Guan Yu and noticed a piece of pork on his cart. Zhang Fei roared, “It’s you who stole my meat! Give it back!”
summary_zh: 张飞在集市上发现关羽的小车上放着一块猪肉，误以为是关羽偷的，便愤怒地冲上前大吼，要求归还猪肉。

title_en: The Oath of the Peach Garden
page_text_ocr_zh: 接着张飞走上前去，抓起一把绿豆，瞪着眼睛狠狠地把绿豆拈成了碎面。
page_text_en: Then Zhang Fei walked forward, grabbed a handful of mung beans, and with glaring eyes, crushed them into powder.
summary_zh: 张飞冲到关羽的绿豆车前，抓起一把绿豆，愤怒地将其捏碎，表现出对关羽的强烈不满。

title_en: The Oath of the Peach Garden
page_text_ocr_zh: “你这卖的明明是绿豆粉，哪里是绿豆？你这个大骗子！”张飞大声喊着。
page_text_en: "You're selling mung bean powder, not mung beans! You're a big cheat!" Zhang Fei shouted loudly.
summary_zh: 张飞发现关羽车上的绿豆是粉状的，误以为被欺骗，愤怒地指责关羽是骗子。

title_en: The Oath of the Peach Garden
page_text_ocr_zh: 关羽气坏了，叫道：“你竟敢来这里闹事！”他抓起一把绿豆向张飞扔去。
page_text_en: Guan Yu was furious and shouted, “How dare you cause trouble here!” He grabbed a handful of mung beans and threw them at Zhang Fei.
summary_zh: 关羽因张飞捏碎绿豆而愤怒，抓起一把绿豆向张飞扔去。

title_en: The Oath of the Peach Garden
page_text_ocr_zh: “你这个贼，偷了我的肉不说，现在又到这里来骗人，看我今天怎么教训你！”说完，张飞一拳就把关羽打倒在地。
page_text_en: "You thief, not only did you steal my meat, but now you're here deceiving people. Watch how I teach you a lesson today!" After saying that, Zhang Fei punched Guan Yu to the ground.
summary_zh: 张飞因误会关羽偷肉并欺骗他，愤怒地将关羽一拳打倒在地，周围的人惊愕地围观。

title_en: The Oath of the Peach Garden
page_text_ocr_zh: “我是看见石头上的字条才割下肉的！我看你是反悔了，存心来找茬的！”关羽一拳打在张飞的脸上，两个人把整条街打得乱七八糟的。
page_text_en: "I saw the note on the stone and that's why I cut the meat! I think you're backing out and deliberately looking for trouble!" Guan Yu punched Zhang Fei in the face. The two of them made a complete mess of the whole street.
summary_zh: 关羽向张飞解释自己是看到字条才取肉，认为张飞是故意找茬，于是挥拳打向张飞，两人在街上激烈打斗，场面混乱。

title_en: The Oath of the Peach Garden
page_text_ocr_zh: 两个人的力气大极了，围观的人都不敢去劝架。这时，只见一位挑着草鞋的人走上前，他一只手抓住张飞，另一只手抓住关羽，一下子就把他们分开了。
page_text_en: The two of them were incredibly strong, and the onlookers dared not intervene. At that moment, a man carrying straw shoes stepped forward. He grabbed Zhang Fei with one hand and Guan Yu with the other, and immediately separated them.
summary_zh: 关羽和张飞因误会激烈打斗，围观者不敢劝架，最终一位挑草鞋的人上前将两人拉开。

title_en: The Oath of the Peach Garden
page_text_ocr_zh: 围观的人都拍手叫好。关羽和张飞也都很佩服这个卖草鞋的人，一问，才知道他叫刘备。
page_text_en: The onlookers all clapped and cheered. Guan Yu and Zhang Fei were also very impressed by the man selling straw shoes. After asking him, they learned his name was Liu Bei.
summary_zh: 关羽和张飞因误会打斗后，被一位卖草鞋的男子拉开，两人对他表示佩服，并得知他名叫刘备。

title_en: The Oath of the Peach Garden
page_text_ocr_zh: 真是不打不相识啊！三个人越说越投机，最后来到桃园，对天盟誓，结拜成了兄弟。
page_text_en: It's true that we don't know each other until we fight! The three of us got along better and better as we talked, and finally came to the peach garden, where we took an oath to the heavens and became sworn brothers.
summary_zh: 关羽、张飞和刘备在桃园中对天盟誓，结拜为兄弟。
